mechanism: Propylthiouracil can inhibit hepatic metabolism of amitriptyline through CYP450 enzyme suppression during thyroid hormone normalization, potentially increasing amitriptyline levels; additionally, both drugs carry agranulocytosis risk.
action: Monitor amitriptyline levels and efficacy; watch for anticholinergic toxicity signs; baseline and periodic CBC monitoring recommended for both agents; consider dose adjustment if toxicity emerges.
